uutiset.t: Punishing start for Pochettino as size of Man Utd mess made clear
uutiset.s: Well, they ran. They had to because there were only 10 of them for all but the first seven minutes. If running were the only problem then this mess might soon be solvable. But Manchester United's 4-0 defeat to Liverpool at Anfield highlighted more flaws than that.
